name: Cyberpunk cel shader
doc: Cel-shades media or a fallback generator into hard magenta, cyan, and acid-yellow neon tone bands with glowing bass-driven ink outlines, angled city-night rain streaks, holographic scanlines, and onset chromatic glitch tears.

in.doc: source media image or video (e.g. core-media.out)

fallback.doc: optional generator subject used automatically when no host media is picked

palette.doc: city-night neon palette (deep indigo, magenta, cyan, acid yellow)

bands.doc: number of hard cel-shading tone bands

neon_mix.doc: blend from posterized source hues to cyberpunk neon tone bands

ink.doc: dark ink outline weight along subject and cel edges

ink_glow.doc: bass-driven glowing neon halo around ink outlines

rain.doc: angled neon city-night rain streak intensity

scanlines.doc: holographic scanlines and beat-synced visor sweep

glitch.doc: onset-triggered chromatic tear and slice displacement

glow.doc: overall neon emission and bass-driven glow
